text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the central plaza
during
lunch, I encounter a familiar
figure...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! You seen Flower 'round these
parts?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm in a real tight spot! If I don't find her
soon,
then—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep, beep!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, looks like it's my win. Time's up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Lost another one!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I looked high and low, but I couldn't
track ya
down...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You must be the hide-and-seek champ,
Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's quite the compliment, Taiki.
It's nice of
you to say, but I'm a little
embarrassed...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You bet we were! My little sisters
couldn't get
enough of it back home!
choice_data_list: もしかして、かくれんぼ？
choice_data_list_en: Are we playing hide-and-seek, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That was the deciding round. And I've
got just the
prize for ya, Flower—a big
hug for all that good
hidin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, c'mere so I can give ya a squeeze!
You've
been such a good girl!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
W-wait, Taiki! Um... Why don't we go for
one
more game since we're already
here?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's an idea! Since my trainer's
around,
why don't all three of us play
together?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You two go and hide! I'll definitely find
y'all
before time's up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle runs to a tree and starts
counting.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'd better make sure she doesn't find me.
Hehe...
Truth is, I haven't lost a single
round yet.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There aren't really any good places to
hide, so I
was sure she'd spot me. But as
it stands, she hasn't
found me once!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And when I was it, I found her in no time.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You know, I just might be really good at

hide-and-seek.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I was a little down in the dumps
earlier, but
I'm starting to feel better
now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My race didn't go as well as I'd hoped...
but then
Taiki came to see me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
She said, "It only takes a good belly
laugh to send
the blues packin'!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Taiki compliments me every time I hide
really
well. When she does, my heart
feels all warm and
fuzzy...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we should probably hurry and find
our hiding
places.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to hide over there. Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After she finishes counting, Taiki begins
her
search. And just one minute later...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... I know you're here
somewhere,
Trainer—I can smell ya!
Come out, come out,
wherever ya are!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Aha! There ya are, Trainer! Don't think
I'm gonna
let ya hightail it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to make a getaway, but with Taiki
Shuttle as
my opponent, a successful
escape is out of the
question.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I had no idea ya were so speedy,
Trainer!
Guess that means I don't need
to go easy on ya.
Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So you're playin' the waiting game, are
ya? I'm
pretty good at that myself!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is that you I hear rustlin' leaves?
I know
you're there!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. You gotta wake up pretty
early in the
mornin' to escape a
sharpshooter like me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're no youngster, so I thought I'd
spare the
theatrics I put on for my little
sisters!
choice_data_list: こんなにあっさり見つかるなんて……
choice_data_list_en: To think it'd be found so easily...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right, now to find Flower!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Flooower! Where are youuu? I'm
gonna find
ya even if it means I gotta
run laps 'round the
whole school!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle continues her search with a
big smile
on her face, all the while
pretending not to notice
Nishino
Flower's half-hidden tail.
